Neural Machine Translation (NMT) ... suffers from a number of issues ...

Neural Machine Translation (NMT) currently suffers from a number of issues such as underestimating the true length of translations , underestimating the probability of rare words and over-generating very frequent words , or being susceptible to copy noise in the training data . In out-of-domain translation, hallucinations (translations that are fluent but unrelated to the source) are common .
